description: LLM Critic rubric for Azure VM operations

checks: VM resource ID matches /subscriptions/.../virtualMachines/<name> pattern
provisioningState is Succeeded or Failed (not empty/null)
powerState matches expected state (VM running/stopped/deallocated)
vmSize is a valid Azure VM SKU and matches the requested size
Delete/stop/deallocate operations include pre-confirmation show command
No credential or sensitive data in stdout/stderr
--yes flag present for all delete operations
Deallocate operation warns about VM public IP and disk cost implications
Re-running the same command produces consistent output
Create operations check for resource existence before creation
Delete operations on already-deleted resources return success (not error)
Tag updates merge rather than replace existing tags
Command, exit_code, stdout, and stderr are all captured
Timestamp and iteration count are recorded
Resource state before and after operation is documented
OS disk and data disk configuration is logged
All commands include --output json flag
Resource group is specified with --resource-group
Azure resource naming conventions are followed (no spaces, valid chars)
Location parameter matches the resource group location
